description:
Implement swipe-to-delete and swipe-to-mark-watched gestures on watchlist items, similar to iOS Mail. Support both left and right swipe directions with customizable actions (remove, mark watched/unwatched, share). Include undo toast notifications for accidental deletions.

**Rationale:** Managing watchlists currently requires multiple taps through menus. Swipe gestures provide instant, muscle-memory-friendly actions that significantly speed up content curation and reduce interaction friction.
title: Swipe Gestures for Watchlist Management
